state.description: The text to read and predict from. Must be non-empty unless images or documents are sent. Text answers are spans of this string.

fields.description: Required. Map of field name to a typed field spec. At least one field; no upper limit. Each prompt (state plus fields) must fit in 65,273 input tokens; input is never truncated and oversized requests are rejected. Unknown keys for a field's type are rejected.

type.description: compute: a number derived from the input. boolean, enum, object: generated answers constrained to that shape.

nullable.description: When false, text, number, boolean, enum and object answers cannot be null. compute requires true.

unit.description: number, compute, duration, list, estimate, forecast. For durations, one of seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years (default seconds).

integer.description: number, compute, duration and number lists only.

decimals.description: number, compute, duration and number lists only. Values are rounded half-up.

knowledge.description: text, number, and text/number lists only. Allows answers from prior knowledge that do not appear in the input. Not combinable with source_only.

source_only.description: number, date, time, datetime, and number/date lists only. The answer must be printed in the input and is normalized from the printed text. Not combinable with null_threshold or knowledge.

pattern.description: text only. Regular expression the answer must match.

enum.description: Allowed values. Required for enum fields; optional for text, number and list fields.

properties.description: Required for object fields and object list items. Map of property name to a spec whose type is text, number, boolean or enum.

items.description: Required for list fields: "text", "number", "date", or an object item spec.

max_items.description: List only. Maximum number of items to return.

min.description: Required for estimate/forecast: a number, or an ISO date for date estimates.

max.description: Required for estimate/forecast: a number, or an ISO date for date estimates.

step.description: Estimate grid: a positive number (days for date estimates), or "month" / "year".

null_threshold.description: compute, date, time, datetime and duration only. Probability of null above which the value is null (default 0.5).

images.description: Optional embedded PNG, JPEG or WebP images placed before the state (max 4; 4 MiB each, 8 MiB total decoded across images and documents; request body max 16 MiB). Remote URLs are not accepted.

rotation.description: Clockwise rotation to apply. Orientation is detected automatically when omitted.

documents.description: Optional embedded PDFs (4 MiB each). Rendered pages plus images must total at most 4. Encrypted PDFs are rejected.

reference_date.description: ISO date that anchors dates written without a year.

return_state_text.description: Return the text that spans index into.
